title: Android Wear complications display null using native algorithm
body: The watch face displays bg values correctly, and when using xdrip algorithm with g5 values displayed properly on complication.  Now using G6 and native, complication displays null.

comments.body: Using 7/21 nightly on wear 2.0, pixel 2 xl 9.0 beta.
A fix for this is in the works
Going to throw a "me too" out there. I had no issues with this until I switched to G6 and the nightly build this week.

Please try the July 26th nightly, it should address this and also enable syncing of back-filled data.

If you are using a Wear 2.0 device then remember you need to uninstall and reinstall the wear app because it doesn't automatically update.
Confirmed, the complication is now working on my Moto 360 2nd Gen. Thanks for your efforts!
One question, where is the syncing of back-filled data option at?
@cwpeterson its not an option, if you're using the native algorithm then the data will be back-filled and (now) synced properly.
